Upstairs offers four generous bedrooms, including a luxurious primary retreat with a spa-inspired ensuite, large walk-in closet, and convenient upper-level laundry. The unfinished basement with 9.5 ft ceilings and large windows offers endless potential. A triple attached finished garage completes the home, along with the unique opportunity to customize select finishes and truly make it your own. (id:67522)
